large-title.purpose: Screen name; artist name on the artist page.

section.purpose: Section headers, sheet titles, the landing card headline.

headline.purpose: Artist names, caught-up line, compact bar title, 44 button labels, stat numbers, state headlines.

callout.purpose: Fav count, score, burst row, new-posts pill, See all, sheet rows, list row titles, menu rows, tag targets, the quiet button, bold counts.

body.purpose: Subtitles, inputs, steps, the sentence under a state headline.

footnote.purpose: Time and post number under a name, row subtitles and values, stat labels.

tag.purpose: Tag text, in the e621 category colour.

footnote-rounded.purpose: New, Follow, +N tag, video length, Play count, group and field labels, small segmented control, grid numbers, the offline banner; tabular figures.

tab.purpose: Tab labels and badges, the +N artists pill, the rating letter.

handle.purpose: Raw e621 name under the artist name on the artist page; the API key in its field.

post-id.purpose: Post number in the ... sheet; what e621 said, in an error; a finished step's count in a checklist.

tag-list.purpose: A tag name as a row title, in its category colour: Tune, search suggestions.

shadows.name: lit
shadows.purpose: Top light on raised things and panels.

shadows.name: lit-fav
shadows.purpose: Top light on the favourited pill.

shadows.name: lip
shadows.purpose: Pressable edge; 4px on Play, 2px on Follow. --lip-c is #0A1B38 under navy, #A8871F under gold, #291A35 under the favourited pill.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Under Play (0 8px 18px pressed). The new-posts pill and the tag targets use 0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4).

shadows.name: tab-bar
shadows.value: outline copy 10px lower, blur(14px), 50% black; 1px rgba(255,255,255,.16) top edge stroke

shadows.name: selected-ring
shadows.purpose: Selected filter chip, focused field, pinned toggle, the tag target under the finger.

shadows.name: glass-over-art-ring
shadows.purpose: Video play disc and mute; player buttons.

motion.name: lip-press
motion.purpose: translateY(lip) and the lip closing to 0. Mock.

motion.name: chip-press
motion.purpose: scale to .96. Mock.

motion.name: favourite-pop
motion.purpose: heart scale .7 → 1.3 → 1. Mock.

motion.name: heart-goo-drip
motion.value: 720 ms; sag cubic-bezier(.25,1.6,.45,1), pull back cubic-bezier(.5,0,.2,1)
motion.purpose: bead, three necks and blobs under the pill; the drop leaves for the tab bar at 380 ms. Mock.

motion.name: double-tap-heart
motion.purpose: one 88 heart over the picture. Mock.

motion.name: mark-spin
motion.purpose: one turn, on favourite and on follow. Mock.

motion.name: follow-wiggle
motion.purpose: rotate −3° → 2° → 0. Mock.

motion.name: follow-dots
motion.purpose: six 5 px dots, from the mark's rim, 30 px out. Mock.

motion.name: tab-capsule
motion.purpose: rotation about the bend's centre. Mock.

motion.name: tab-icon-hop
motion.purpose: up 5 px, scale 1.12; label colour 200 ms. Mock.

motion.name: tab-bar-scroll
motion.value: spring (stiffness 210, damping 21); rubber band past the ends
motion.purpose: rail rotation. Mock.

motion.name: goo-spurt-secret-tab
motion.value: 400 ms squeeze; ten drops in spurts of 4, 3, 3, 133 ms apart, each 240 ms plus 1.4 ms per px travelled
motion.purpose: drops on ballistic arcs, stretched along their speed. Mock.

motion.name: goo-wipe
motion.value: 900 ms blade, then a 520 ms gleam
motion.purpose: blade rotation, flung drops, gleam. Mock.

motion.name: play-hide-return
motion.value: 200 ms ease-out; returns after 1 s idle
motion.purpose: opacity and translateY(24px). Mock.

motion.name: compact-bar
motion.value: 150 ms ease-out, past 64 px of scroll
motion.purpose: opacity. Mock.

motion.name: tuck
motion.purpose: card scale 95% ↔ 100%, 16 px rise, opacity 55% ↔ 100%. Mock.

motion.name: skeleton-shimmer
motion.purpose: a light band crossing each well shape. Mock.

motion.name: caught-up
motion.purpose: app mark turns one notch (45°). Mock.

motion.name: segmented-capsule
motion.purpose: translateX to the chosen segment. Mock.

motion.name: menu-capsule
motion.purpose: translateY to the chosen row. Mock.

motion.name: switch
motion.value: knob 300 ms cubic-bezier(.3,1.35,.5,1); track colour 200 ms
motion.purpose: knob translateX 20 px. Mock.

motion.name: glass-back-and-toggle-press
motion.purpose: scale to .94. Mock.

motion.name: hero-follow-dots
motion.purpose: six 7 px dots from the 80 mark's rim. Mock.

motion.name: player-heart
motion.purpose: the favourite pop, on the glass heart. Mock.

motion.name: field-caret
motion.purpose: caret opacity. Mock.

motion.name: tag-targets-pop
motion.value: 320 ms cubic-bezier(.3,1.35,.5,1), each 40 ms after the last
motion.purpose: from 60% scale and 10 px lower, fading in. Mock.

motion.name: tag-target-under-the-finger
motion.purpose: scale to 1.06, ring. Mock.

motion.name: goo-s-wave
motion.value: 900 ms ease-in-out, three times, 400 ms after it appears
motion.purpose: the arm turns 16° about its shoulder; two ticks fade in and out. Mock.

motion.name: goo-s-squash
motion.purpose: 107% × 90% about its base under the finger; back through 94% × 109% and 103% × 97%. Mock.

motion.name: goo-s-spurt
motion.value: 120 ms after the tap; 1 to 3 drops 70 ms apart, each 70 + 17(√rise + √(rise + fall)) ms
motion.purpose: drops rise 22 to 40 px from the tip, then fall to the tab bar, stretched along their speed. Mock.

motion.name: goo-busy
motion.value: 3.2 s looping glance; dots 1.2 s, 0.2 s apart
motion.purpose: the face slides 3.5 left and right with a hold at each end; three dots light up in turn. Mock.

motion.name: checklist
motion.value: spinner 0.8 s a turn; check 320 ms pop
motion.purpose: the running step spins; a finished step's check pops in like the heart. Mock.

motion.name: check-well
motion.value: 150 ms ease-out fill; check 320 ms pop
motion.purpose: the well turns Score Green and its check pops in. Mock.

motion.name: goo-s-snooze
motion.purpose: the "z" drift 2 px right and 3 px up, to 60%. Mock.

motion.name: slow-down-count
motion.purpose: the number in the sentence. Mock.

motion.name: new-posts-pill
motion.value: slides in under the header; posts insert with a slide-down, keeping the reading position
motion.purpose: translateY, opacity. Spec (not in mock).

motion.name: tab-content
motion.purpose: content opacity. Spec (not in mock).

motion.name: push-back
motion.value: 150 ms cross-fade + 8 px rise; gesture back never animates
motion.purpose: opacity, translateY. Spec (not in mock).

motion.name: player-open-close
motion.value: 200 ms fade-up from the card / fade out
motion.purpose: opacity, translateY. Spec (not in mock).

motion.name: player-controls
motion.value: auto-hide after 2.5 s playing; stay while paused or focused; 250 ms double-tap guard
motion.purpose: opacity. Spec (not in mock).

motion.name: sheets
motion.value: spring up; drag to dismiss with rubber-banding
motion.purpose: translateY. Spec (not in mock).

motion.name: pull-to-refresh
motion.value: indicator follows at half the finger; 144 px travel arms; spinner holds at 48 px for at least 400 ms
motion.purpose: translateY. Spec (not in mock).

motion.name: toast-in-out
motion.value: in: 320 ms cubic-bezier(.3,1.35,.5,1), rises 12 px and fades in; out: 200 ms ease-in, drops 8 px and fades. Stays 6 s with Undo, 4 s without; role="status"
motion.purpose: opacity, translateY. Spec (not in mock).

motion.name: undo-ring
motion.value: empties clockwise in 6 s, linear; paused on hover or focus
motion.purpose: stroke-dashoffset. Spec (not in mock).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No pop, wiggle, spin, hop, dots, drip, flying drops, Tuck or shimmer; capsules (tab, segmented, menu) and the switch knob move instantly; tag targets appear without the pop; Goo the mascot holds still; goo still shows and updates in place.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The e621 Reading Room"**

A calm, dark room built from e621's own Hexagon navies, where the art is the only bright thing. Each post sits in a navy e621 panel, like e621's post boxes: who made it on top, the picture, then tags, score and favourite underneath. Structure is iOS (large title, bottom sheets, a floating tab bar).

The room is made of three materials, all lit from above. Things you press are **raised**: a light on top and a solid darker edge underneath that closes when pressed. Posts sit in **panels**. The picture and the tags are **sunk** into the panel. There are no outlines doing the work of depth.

The personality is physical and a little cheeky, and it stays off the art: a rounded voice face (Fredoka), a tab bar that is one bent tube with a capsule that slides along the bend, artist marks that spin when you follow or favourite, and white goo that drips under the heart and slowly builds up on the tab bar as you favourite.

Density is phone-first and one-handed: a 16 edge, a closed size system (three control heights, five gaps, two nested radii), and the main action in thumb reach at the bottom left. Dark by default; there is no light theme.

The art is never tinted, framed by gradients or covered. The only things that may sit on a picture are the video play glyph, the video length and the mute button; the player adds its own controls, which auto-hide.
keyCharacteristics: e621 navies as the neutral; one gold, used sparingly.
Three materials (raised, panel, sunk), flat fills with a 1 px top light. No gradients, no hairline outlines.
Fredoka for voice, the system face for reading.
A solid same-hue lip on pressables, closing in 100 ms.
Colour carries meaning: gold = act / new / here, green = score, pink = favourite, e621 tag category colours on tags.
"Bends" marks for artists (e621 has no artist pictures); the kaleidoscope is the app mark.
Goo: white, slow, earned by favouriting, wiped from Settings.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold fills one thing per screen: its main action. Everywhere else gold is a label, a dot, a ring or a glyph that says "new" or "you are here". A second gold fill on a screen is a bug. Where a screen asks you to sign in, Sign in is that one fill: on the landing, Play stays hidden until the card that holds Sign in has scrolled away.

rules.name: The Art Is the Light Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the interface is more saturated than the art. Navy is the neutral; meaning colours appear only as small icons, numbers and tag text. Goo is white like text, and it never touches a picture. That goes for Goo the mascot too: white, a pale blue underside, navy eyes, and pink only on its cheeks and tongue.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Fredoka for what the app says (names, numbers, actions); system for what you read. Nothing in between, and no sizes outside the table.

rules.name: The Lip Is a Promise Rule
rules.body: A lip means "press me, and something happens". It goes on Play, the fav pill, Follow, the burst row, the new-posts pill, gold or tonal buttons, the stepper's buttons and the player's Play / Pause. Never on panels, rows, fields, tags, chips, toggles, the segmented control, menus, the tools capsule, back buttons, tabs, tag targets (you drag onto them as often as you press them; they answer by growing), or anything over art. Goo the mascot's underside is its thickness, not a lip: it does not close when pressed. Goo is a toy, not a control: a tap squashes it and spurts goo, and nothing in the app depends on that. Chips answer a press by shrinking to 96%; tags by darkening.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Light comes from above on every surface: raised things are lit on top, sunk things are dark on top. Never a gradient fill, never a glow, never an outline around a panel.

dos: **Do** keep every value on the closed size system: gaps 4/8/12/16/24, an 8 edge inside panels and a 16 edge on the screen, heights 44/36/28, badges 16/20/24, radii 24 with 16 nested inside.
**Do** make everything pressable a raised thing with a lip, and everything that only sits there a panel or a well.
**Do** fill gold once per screen, for the main action; use gold otherwise only for "New", the current tab, a selected chip's ring and the Follow plus.
**Do** put the artist on top of a post and the heart at the right end of its footer, with the score beside it.
**Do** give 36 and 28 controls a 44 touch area, and every number tabular figures.
**Do** keep any new small-text colour at 4.5:1 on the surface it sits on, keeping its e621 hue.
donts: **Don't** put anything on top of the art except the video play glyph, length and mute (and the player's own auto-hiding controls). The double-tap heart is the one thing that may flash over a picture.
**Don't** tint or frame art with colour washes; navy panels may surround it, never cover it.
**Don't** draw depth with outlines, gradients or glows. One light, from above.

**Don't** put a lip on panels, rows, fields, tags, chips, toggles, menus, tabs, tag targets or anything over art, and don't add blurred shadows beyond Play (and the Follow button that stands in its place), the new-posts pill, tag targets and the tab bar. Don't give an offline banner or a state's panel a lip either.
**Don't** use Fredoka at 700, or for tags and reading text.
**Don't** use a second accent colour, meaning colours as large fills, gold in an artist's mark, or a second gold fill on a screen (the artist page has no "Play all").
**Don't** put muted text on Raised Highlight (3.7:1).

**Don't** let goo touch a picture, hide a label, or be cleaned anywhere but Settings, and don't put Goo the mascot anywhere but the landing, needs sign-in, empty states, errors and the first read of your favorites.
**Don't** borrow Duolingo's owl, green, streaks, gems or guilt nudges, or AllTrails' green, logo or buttons on photos.
